review_status: Evidence reviewed 2026-11-17. CDFW species and tagging sources support reef-edge habitat, seasonal movement and adult depth; experienced water temperature is not a preferred SST curve.

profile.size: Min limit 14 inches TL / Bag limit 5 per harvester / day
profile.diet: Small fish, crustaceans, squids, and pelagic prey
profile.behavior: Navigates West Coast kelp forests, rocky reefs, and coastal upwelling zones.

factors.reason_template: Water is {value} C, inside preferred Pacific temperature range for barred sand bass.
factors.value_notes: CDFW tracking figures show barred sand bass experiencing roughly 11-19 °C water during representative seasonal movements, and CDFW describes summer spawning migrations. These are ambient temperatures at fish depth, not a validated preferred surface-temperature curve; they do not establish the configured 14-23 °C range or 16-21 °C ideal as catch suitability bands.

factors.reason_template: Depth is {value} m, within prime Pacific depth zone for barred sand bass.
factors.value_notes: CDFW habitat sources report adults/subadults most abundant around 5.2-26 m, with occurrence to about 183 m; adults occupy the sand/rock ecotone and spawning aggregations form over soft bottom. The configured 2-40 m range is plausible for nearshore adults, but the 4-35 m ideal is not a measured depth-preference curve and juveniles use sheltered bays/shallows.

text.day: Full daylight when Pacific gamefish actively hunt.

timing.note: West Coast captain reports and biological upwelling patterns.
